name: Keeping Your Word
overview: Scripture emphasizes the seriousness of making and keeping vows, especially those made before the Lord, underscoring that what proceeds from our lips must be faithfully fulfilled. Leviticus 5:4 and Deuteronomy 23:23 highlight the accountability one has when swearing oaths or making promises, and Ecclesiastes 5:4 warns against delaying their fulfillment. Jesus reinforces this in Matthew 5:33 by commanding believers to perform their oaths to God, reflecting a heart committed to truth and integrity. Ultimately, the believer’s commitment to keep their word is grounded in reverence for God’s commands and a desire to live in obedience to Him.
